_comment: F-067 hand-authored by-entry overrides. These are AUTHORED data, not derived:
the generator merges them over the blanket roster, and an entry listed here
always wins. Edit this file to change an override, then re-run
`zep world item stack-sizes`. Do NOT hand-edit the emitted SQL.
'stackable' and 'maxcount' are both optional per entry - omit one to leave it alone.
'_exclude' lists entries F-067 must not touch at all, because another file owns
the row outright. Excluding keeps single-file ownership intact instead of
restating another feature's value here and having two files fight over it.
